UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; Copy-Item -Path 'release_full\Nimbus\*' -Destination './' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Remove-Item -Path 'release_full' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Write-Output 'Nimbus Proxy installed'"
-c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && cp -rf release_full/Nimbus/. ./ && rm -rf release_full && echo \"Nimbus Proxy installed\""

-c "DotnetVersion=\"{{DotnetVersion}}\"; cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && if [[ -x Dotnet/dotnet ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(Dotnet/dotnet --list-runtimes | sed -n \"s/^Microsoft\.AspNetCore\.App \([0-9.]*\) .*/\1/p\" | head -n1); else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; if [[ -z \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then DotnetVersion=$(wget -qO- https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/10.0/releases.json | jq -r \".[\\\"latest-runtime\\\"]\"); fi; if [[ ! \"$DotnetVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\" && exit 1; elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f dotnet.tar.gz ]] && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO dotnet.tar.gz https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-linux-x64.tar.gz || { echo \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf Dotnet/* >/dev/null 2>&1 && tar -xzf dotnet.tar.gz -C Dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\"; fi"

-c "DotnetVersion=\"{{DotnetVersion}}\"; cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && if [[ -x Dotnet/dotnet ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(Dotnet/dotnet --list-runtimes | sed -n \"s/^Microsoft\.AspNetCore\.App \([0-9.]*\) .*/\1/p\" | head -n1); else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; if [[ -z \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then DotnetVersion=$(wget -qO- https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/10.0/releases.json | jq -r \".[\\\"latest-runtime\\\"]\"); fi; if [[ ! \"$DotnetVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\" && exit 1; elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f dotnet.tar.gz ]] && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO dotnet.tar.gz https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-linux-arm64.tar.gz || { echo \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf Dotnet/* >/dev/null 2>&1 && tar -xzf dotnet.tar.gz -C Dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\"; fi"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{{DotnetVersion}}'; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if (Test-Path 'Dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& Dotnet/dotnet.exe --list-runtimes | Where-Object { $_ -like 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.App*' } | Select-Object -First 1).Split()[1] } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/10.0/releases.json)."latest-runtime" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1 }; Remove-Item Dotnet/* -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; Expand-Archive dotnet.zip -DestinationPath Dotnet -Force; Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"
